mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM project_artifact WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND file_name = #{fileName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_artifact (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, task_id, expert_run_id, version, storage_key, file_name, media_type, status, created_by) VALUES (#{artifact.id}, #{tenantId}, #{artifact.projectId}, #{artifact.taskId}, #{artifact.expertRunId}, #{artifact.version}, #{artifact.storageKey}, #{artifact.fileName}, #{artifact.mediaType}, #{artifact.status}, #{createdBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE business_id = business_id
mapper.update: UPDATE project_artifact SET size_bytes = #{size}, sha256 = #{sha256}, status = 'AVAILABLE', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{id} AND status = 'UPLOADING'
